fact: 1908年7月初，驻马其顿雷森（Resen/Resne）的第三军团军官艾哈迈德·尼亚齐贝伊（Ahmed Niyazi）与恩维尔贝伊（Enver Bey）率部起事，提出恢复1876年宪法的要求，青年土耳其革命由此爆发并迅速蔓延至马其顿各地。

sources.title: ФАКТИ.БГ — July 3, 1908. Revolt of the Young Turks in Macedonia
sources.quote: On July 3, 1908, Major Ahmed Niyazi Bey and Enver Bey raised a rebellion among the soldiers of the Third Army, stationed in the Macedonian city of Resen.

sources.title: Taylor & Francis — The Young Turks and their enemies, 1908–1918（William Hale）
sources.quote: In June 1908 the revolutionaries in Salonica began to fear that government agents were on their way to uncovering their organisation. The timing of their revolt was probably determined by the urgent need to forestall counter-moves by the Sultan.

fact: 1908年7月23日，统一和进步协会（CUP）向苏丹阿卜杜勒·哈米德二世发出要求恢复宪法的最后通牒；7月23—24日，苏丹宣布恢复自1878年起被中止近三十年的1876年宪法，第二宪政时代（İkinci Meşrutiyet）由此开始。

sources.title: Britannica — Young Turk Revolution (1908)
sources.quote: Major Ahmed Niyazi led a revolt on July 3, 1908, which spread rapidly, and on July 23, Abdülhamid II announced the restoration of the 1876 constitution

sources.title: Wikipedia — 1908
sources.quote: July 23 – Young Turk Revolution: The Committee of Union and Progress (CUP) issues a formal ultimatum to Sultan Abdul Hamid II, to restore the constitution of 1876 within the Ottoman Empire; it is restored the following day.

fact: 1908年秋冬，奥斯曼帝国举行革命后首次大选；新一届众议院（Meclis-i Mebusan）于1908年12月17日在君士坦丁堡开幕。含补选共288名议员，民族构成为突厥人147、阿拉伯人60、阿尔巴尼亚人27、希腊人26、亚美尼亚人14、斯拉夫人10、犹太人4。

sources.quote: Throughout the autumn of 1908 Ottoman citizens were busy electing their deputies to the new Ottoman parliament, which was officially opened on 17th December. Of a total of 288 deputies, 147 were Turks, 60 were Arabs, 27 were Albanians, 26 were Greeks, 14 were Armenians, 10 were Slavs and 4 were Jews.

fact: 1908年10月5日，仍处于奥斯曼宗主权下的保加利亚宣布完全独立；次日（10月6日），奥匈帝国宣布吞并波斯尼亚-黑塞哥维那。青年土耳其革命后的数周内，帝国即在巴尔干遭遇双重领土与主权损失。

sources.quote: During the second half of 1908, a wave of strikes shook the Empire. From 24th July to the end of that year, 111 strikes were organised across the Empire, from Salonica to İstanbul, Aydın to Beirut, Adana to Monastur (Bitola). This density in worker activism has not been seen again in Turkish history down to the present

fact: 1908年恢复实施的1876年《奥斯曼宪法》（Kanun-i Esasi）第8条规定：帝国所有臣民不分族裔、语言与宗教一律称为奥斯曼人，构成宪政公民身份的法律基础；该条随宪政恢复重新生效，理论上为穆斯林与非穆斯林提供了平等的臣民/公民地位。

fact: 阿卜杜勒·哈米德二世时代延续约三十年的严格新闻审查在1908年宪政恢复后于实务中停止执行：报界普遍假定审查已废除，出版活动迅速繁荣，数月内官方发放了数百份报纸许可证，形成了短暂而真实的新闻自由窗口（1909年三三一事件后审查又逐步回潮）。

sources.title: 1914-1918-Online — Press/Journalism (Ottoman Empire)
sources.quote: The Young Turk Revolution in 1908 ended the three-decade long reign of Abdulhamid II, Sultan of the Turks (1842-1918), which was notorious for strict press censorship. After the constitution was proclaimed, Ottoman journalists assumed that censorship was abolished, and the press started flourishing rapidly. Within a few months, hundreds of newspaper licenses were issued.

sources.title: ebrary — The 1908 Revolution, The Second Constitutional Period
sources.quote: Press censorship was lifted, and the Ottoman reading public experienced a press boom of unprecedented proportions.

fact: 君士坦丁堡设有帝国的官方证券交易所——德萨德特证券交易所（Dersaadet Tahvilat Borsası）：其前身1866年依政府法令设立，用于交易克里米亚战争外债债券；1873年法令正式定名，采用类似法国证券市场的制度，1908年仍在运营，是加拉塔金融区债券与股票交易的中心。

sources.title: Wikipedia — Borsa Istanbul（Early days of the securities market in Turkey）
sources.quote: The first securities market in the Ottoman Empire was established in Istanbul in 1866 for refinancing the Ottoman foreign debt taken during the Crimean War (1853–1856) through government bonds. With a law in 1873 it was formally renamed as the Dersaadet Securities Exchange (Turkish: Dersaadet Tahvilat Borsası).

sources.title: DergiPark — The Foundation of Turkish Capital Markets: The Pivotal Role of Galata Bankers
sources.quote: The first securities exchange market called "Dersaadet Tahvilat Borsası" in İstanbul, and similar to the French securities market system, opened by government order in 1866.

fact: 帝国奥斯曼银行（Banque Impériale Ottomane / Bank-ı Osmanî-i Şahane）自1863年重组起享有奥斯曼境内独家发钞权，由英法资本与奥斯曼政府合资；其总部位于君士坦丁堡加拉塔的银行街（Bankalar Caddesi），是帝国财政、汇兑与信贷体系的核心机构。

sources.title: Conant, A History of Modern Banks of Issue（1915，FRASER存档）
sources.quote: The Imperial Ottoman Bank at Constantinople received the exclusive privilege of note issue in Turkey when it was founded in 1863. The capital was furnished by British and French capitalists

sources.title: Wikipedia (IPFS镜像) — Ottoman Bank
sources.quote: The Ottoman Bank (Turkish: Osmanlı Bankası), formerly the Imperial Ottoman Bank (Ottoman Turkish: Bank-ı Osmanî-i Şahane; French: Banque Impériale Ottomane), was a bank founded in 1856 at Bankalar Caddesi (Banks Street) in the Galata business quarter of Constantinople (now Istanbul), the capital of the Ottoman Empire, as a joint venture between British interests, the Banque de Paris et des Pays-Bas of France, and the Ottoman government.

fact: 根据1881年12月《穆哈兰姆敕令》（Decree of Muharrem），奥斯曼政府将印花税、烟酒、渔业税、丝绸什一税、食盐与烟草专卖等间接收入永久交由欧洲债权人设立的奥斯曼公共债务管理局（OPDA/杜云-乌穆米耶）支配，约占政府收入的五分之一，直至债务清偿；该制度在1908年宪政恢复后继续有效，意味着食盐、烟草等贸易由欧洲主导的债务机构特许控制。

sources.title: TDX — The Ottoman Public Debt Administration (OPDA) in Debt Process of Ottoman Empire（引Eldem, 2005: 441）
sources.quote: With the Muharrem Decree of 1881, the Ottoman authority also agreed to permanently and unconditionally relinquish their share of indirect income derived from various state generated revenues. These included stamp duties, alcohol sales, fishing taxes, the silk harvest tax, salt, and tobacco monopolies. In essence, it entailed that approximately one-fifth of the government's income would be permanently handed over to the OPDA until the entire outstanding debt was settled.

sources.title: UCL Discovery — Tunçer, Reform in the Ottoman Empire（关于穆哈兰姆敕令）
sources.quote: Eventually, in December 1881, the Decree of Muharrem was signed between bondholder representatives and the government.

fact: 1903年修订定约的帝国巴格达铁路公司（Chemin de fer impérial ottoman de Bagdad）获得巴格达铁路特许修筑权：奥斯曼政府按每公里275,000法郎支付建设费，并对每公里每年4,500法郎的铁路毛收入提供担保。公里建设付款加公里运营担保，构成1908年前后帝国铁路特许投资的基本金融结构。

sources.title: Middle East: A History（archive.org存档，关于巴格达铁路特许）

fact: 汉志铁路（大马士革—麦地那，约1,320公里）于1908年建成通车：首列列车1908年8月28日抵达麦地那，9月1日举行庆祝；大马士革至麦地那的铁路旅程缩短至约55小时，帝国朝觐交通方式由骆驼商队大规模转向铁路。

fact: 宪政恢复后帝国出版业爆发式增长：数月内发放数百份报纸许可证，1908年新创刊的主要报纸包括《米利特》（Millet）、《自由》（Hürriyet）、《联盟》（İttifak）与《回声》（Tanin）；其中Tanin第一阶段（1908年8月1日—1918年10月31日）共出版3550号，成为统一进步协会的半官方喉舌。
